commentary: With our market breadth score at 52 and the deterministic gate set to Caution, William O'Neil's top-down market discipline demands patience despite the Nifty reclaiming 25,000 on foreign institutional buying. An explosive index rebound unconfirmed by broad internal participation warrants defensive positioning rather than aggressive capital outlay. In Stan Weinstein's framework, broad-market durability requires expanding Stage 2 participation across industry groups before breakouts reliably follow through. Minervini's progressive exposure rules dictate testing current liquidity with restrained position sizing, zero chasing of extended pivots, and enforcing unforgiving stop discipline until market breadth confirms sustained leadership.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis & Darvas Box Theory

360ONE.technical: Price cleared a 20-session high on 2.25x average volume, confirming institutional accumulation. RSI at 59 signals constructive momentum without overbought extension. Aligned swing lows reflect healthy supply absorption, maintaining compliance above key moving averages.
360ONE.fundamental: Wealth AUM expansion remains solid, but Q2 consolidated net profit contracted ~5% YoY due to mark-to-market investment adjustments, alongside sluggish 4% revenue growth. The deceleration fails CANSLIM minimum 25% earnings expansion hurdles.
360ONE.risk: A breakdown below key swing support at 1142.82 invalidates breakout demand; trigger an immediate stop-loss.

63MOONS.technical: Pattern completed a classic double bottom with neckline pressure near 982.83. The stock trades above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA with an RSI of 56 and bullish MACD, validating constructive base building.
63MOONS.fundamental: Cybersecurity subsidiary orders expanded sharply, driving a 350% revenue surge, but consolidated operations swung into a ₹47.5 crore net loss. Erratic historical profitability and negative return metrics conflict with O'Neil quality criteria.
63MOONS.risk: Violation of the double-bottom support base at 883.03 shatters the technical structure, demanding an instant exit.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Demonstrated a textbook Minervini pullback to the rising 21-EMA followed by a bullish reclaim candle clearing 20-session resistance. RSI at 58 indicates healthy underlying strength with well-ordered moving average alignment.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Lending book and insurance premiums posted strong gains, powering 29% sales growth and a 40% PAT rebound in Q1. Improving operational margins and institutional pedigree support constructive analysis, though sustained multi-quarter acceleration remains pending.
ABCAPITAL.risk: A closing violation beneath the 21-EMA support pivot at 391.17 compromises the setup, requiring a swift exit.

ABSLNN50ET.technical: Cleared 20-session highs on 1.26x average volume with RSI at 66, displaying steady Stage 2 progression above rising 21-day, 50-day, and 200-day moving averages as large-cap momentum expands.
ABSLNN50ET.fundamental: As a passive exchange-traded fund tracking the Nifty Next 50 index, single-stock corporate earnings, margins, ROE, and leverage metrics are not applicable to the security.
ABSLNN50ET.risk: A decline below swing support at 76.15 indicates index-level distribution, dictating defensive risk closure.

ADANIENSOL.technical: Displays textbook Stage 2 continuation after clearing 20-session resistance. RSI at 60 and positive MACD trajectory indicate high relative strength and institutional sponsorship without technical extension beyond the base.
ADANIENSOL.fundamental: Exceptional operational performance with revenue up 53% and PAT surging 145%, backstopped by an ₹87,000 crore transmission order book and smart-meter expansion. Operating EBITDA margins of 33.6% confirm genuine CANSLIM leadership.
ADANIENSOL.risk: A breakdown beneath the breakout pivot level at 1575.77 invalidates the setup; execute disciplined stop capital protection.

ADANIGREEN.technical: Broke out above 20-session resistance with RSI at 63 and positive MACD, preserving an orderly Stage 2 structure above upward-sloping short and long-term moving averages.
ADANIGREEN.fundamental: Top-line revenue advanced 42% on 20.8 GW operational capacity and 89% EBITDA margins, but net profit growth slowed to 16% YoY from 19%, missing O'Neil's 25% threshold amid high capital leverage.
ADANIGREEN.risk: Breaching the structural platform at 1326.34 breaks the ascending trend channel, triggering mandatory risk cut.
